definitions.gloss: to build up, to create, to complete
definitions.explanation: To create or construct something through sustained effort, bringing it to completion. Emphasizes the process and achievement of finishing.

definitions.gloss: to fabricate, to make up, to concoct
definitions.explanation: To invent or fabricate something that is not true, such as a story, image, or false scenario.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}をゼロから{作|つく}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I built the company from scratch.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}かけて{独自|どくじ}のブランドを{作|つく}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I spent ten years building up a unique brand.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}たちが{一丸|いちがん}となって{強|つよ}いチームを{作|つく}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The players united to build a strong team.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}を{作|つく}り{上|あ}げるな。
メディアが{事件|じけん}を{大|おお}げさに{作|つく}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The media fabricated the incident to seem bigger than it was.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}に{仕立|した}て{上|あ}げるために{証拠|しょうこ}を{作|つく}り{上|あ}げた{疑|うたが}いがある。
examples.english: There is suspicion that evidence was fabricated in order to frame someone as the culprit.

notes:
A compound verb from {作|つく}る (to make) + {上|あ}げる (to raise, complete). The {上|あ}げる component adds the nuance of completion or finishing. An ichidan verb. In sense 1, it conveys positive effort and achievement. In sense 2, it has a negative connotation of deception.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゼロから{作|つく}り{上|あ}げる (build from scratch)
- {時間|じかん}をかけて{作|つく}り{上|あ}げる (build up over time)
- {話|はなし}を{作|つく}り{上|あ}げる (fabricate a story)
- {証拠|しょうこ}を{作|つく}り{上|あ}げる (fabricate evidence)
